rows.title: 029 is adverse numerical evidence at 021/021b, not a solved 028b/037b hull.
rows.finding: Weak-meridian endpoints at 11.8/46 mm are below operating pressure. The working shape target must be tighter than those 015 amplitudes within that model. Benchmark and collapse validation are absent; no quantitative physical tolerance or current joined-hull SF is established.

rows.title: 042's permissive dimple map must not override 029.
rows.finding: Keep 042's 9.3–16.1 mm allowance and mapped gamma .69–.95 as conditional monocoque transfers. 029 supplies contradictory numerical evidence at related sandwich points. Neither historical S-II gamma about .2 nor a fabrication tolerance qualifies the new Be hull.

rows.title: 037b uses 037 temperatures whose recovery remains open.
rows.finding: The 200 F/30.3414:1 fix supplies the selected P2 construction model used by 040's common account. CHECK-037's 84 missing thermal/projection inputs remain open; a mechanical reinterpretation does not supply them. Balanced residual compression is not independently established as harmless to global stability.

rows.title: 040's common scalar account retains model and installed-qualification gaps.
rows.finding: 040 recomputes the 037b construction with its own loads, coating, pad and service bill. R10 does not float; R30 ranks least optimism among tested radii. Coating+primer at an assumed .20 kg/m2 and retained water are the largest assumed debits. Keep this account distinct from old 028b/033/037/034 variants and the 044 life spectrum. The original +0.120151 kg is a fixed-geometry allowance; 040 recomputes joining. Neither mass closure nor scalar SF closes installed qualification.

rows.title: 042 changes the in-place seam process without qualifying its mass and strength.
rows.finding: Its 200 F panel bond and proposed room-temperature Be scarf are distinct cures. Do not transfer AF film weight or the 10 MPa scarf screen to the proposed seam paste as measured capability. F1 expands the existing T2 evidence route; it does not certify gamma.

rows.title: This register is a bounded filing snapshot.
rows.finding: All discovered canonical mainline/check reports after the 030b snapshot are incorporated or explicitly dispositioned. Running work supplies no results. Later filings belong to 030d; no seat is polled, restored or contacted out of band.

rows.title: Some 037b infeasible alternatives contain nonstandard JSON Infinity/NaN.
rows.finding: Original source bytes remain pinned verbatim. The current selected finite points are exported as strict JSON. Infeasible alternatives remain referenced with their explicit source disposition; nonfinite entries are not interpreted as capabilities.

rows.title: 040 common static/service account does not close 044 life or 043 reliability.
rows.finding: 040 adopts 037b but uses its own resized one-pad/wind/weather models. 044's six-pad spectrum and 60:1 scarf option belong to older R10 geometries, so its 36.661 kg cannot simply be added as a validated R30 retrofit. 043 uses 022d/026b stress/count cases, not 041's 750-member f5 frame. Carry each as an unresolved geometry-dependent requirement.
